tools.name: agentsearch_web_search
tools.description: Search the web with AgentSearch and return the response as pretty-printed JSON text. Use this when you have a query and need hits rather than a page body; if you already have a URL, use agentsearch_extract instead (or agentsearch_render for JavaScript-heavy pages). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agentsearch_web_search, agentsearch_extract, agentsearch_render, agentsearch_news_search, agentsearch_search_and_read, agentsearch_screenshot · Private data: agentsearch_web_search, agentsearch_extract, agentsearch_render, agentsearch_news_search, agentsearch_search_and_read, agentsearch_screenshot · Public sink: agentsearch_render, agentsearch_news_search · Destructive: agentsearch_extract, agentsearch_news_search, agentsearch_search_and_read, agentsearch_screenshot.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agentsearch_web_search, agentsearch_extract, agentsearch_render, agentsearch_news_search, agentsearch_search_and_read, agentsearch_screenshot · Private data: agentsearch_web_search, agentsearch_extract, agentsearch_render, agentsearch_news_search, agentsearch_search_and_read, agentsearch_screenshot · Public sink: agentsearch_render, agentsearch_news_search · Destructive: agentsearch_extract, agentsearch_news_search, agentsearch_search_and_read, agentsearch_screenshot

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
